# 10 - Prompts

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## MCP prompts (76)

19 reusable prompts, plus 57 generated from the persona registry.
Claude Code installs clean `/pix-*` commands instead and suppresses these
(ADR 029), so the two names are deliberately the same.

### Reusable

| Prompt                 | Arguments  | Description                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/pix-adr`             | <decision> | Record an architecture decision: context, decision, alternatives, consequences                                                                            |
| `/pix-area-ai`         | <request>  | AI agent work: pix-ai and agent-architecture patterns for agent integrations                                                                              |
| `/pix-area-backend`    | <request>  | Backend/API work: node, express, fastify, hono, nestjs, graphql, security                                                                                 |
| `/pix-area-data`       | <request>  | Data-layer work: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, mongodb, duckdb, indexed-db, SQL                                                                              |
| `/pix-area-devops`     | <request>  | DevOps work: docker, observability, testing                                                                                                               |
| `/pix-area-frontend`   | <request>  | Frontend work following pix styleguides: zero CSS classes, semantic HTML, external CSS, TDD + a11y                                                        |
| `/pix-area-platform`   | <request>  | Platform work: web, desktop, agent, library                                                                                                               |
| `/pix-area-process`    | <request>  | Process work: code review, TDD, feature workflow, documentation, ADR, handoff, BMAD                                                                       |
| `/pix-area-skills`     | <request>  | Skill discovery: find, install, and evaluate agent skills                                                                                                 |
| `/pix-area-styleguide` | <request>  | Styleguide work: a11y, css, html, javascript, json, markdown, naming, patterns, validation                                                                |
| `/pix-area-toolchain`  | <request>  | Toolchain configuration: vite, pnpm, turborepo, rspack, parcel, typescript, eslint, biome, husky, commits, project                                        |
| `/pix-area-toolset`    | <request>  | Work with the pix dispatcher/action toolset: routing, gateway, apply, search, check, scaffold, detect, fix, ADR, handoff                                  |
| `/pix-area-ui`         | <request>  | UI design-system work: design-system components, tokens, patterns                                                                                         |
| `/pix-flight`          | [options]  | Read the flight recorder: what this server cost, and what to do about it                                                                                  |
| `/pix-handoff`         | [options]  | Produce a compressed context handoff (ADR summary + git context) to resume in a new session, commiting pending work as scoped Conventional Commits first. |
| `/pix-handon`          | [options]  | Resume: verify the last handoff against the repository as it is now                                                                                       |
| `/pix-init`            | [options]  | Prepare a project for pix-galaxy-mcp: the central recorder directory and tokensave                                                                        |
| `/pix-process-check`   | [target]   | Validate code against the pix guardrails and fix what fails                                                                                               |
| `/pix-update`          | [options]  | Apply an available server update explicitly, and report what changed                                                                                      |

### Persona, one per role and operation

An operation is a prefix of the trio (ADR 057): `audit` writes `docs/audits/`
and stops, `review` adds `docs/reviews/`, `plan` adds `docs/plans/`. Each
takes an optional free-text `request` naming the focus for the run.

| Role            | plan                      | audit                      | review                      |
| --------------- | ------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `a11y`          | `/pix-plan-a11y`          | `/pix-audit-a11y`          | `/pix-review-a11y`          |
| `ai`            | `/pix-plan-ai`            | `/pix-audit-ai`            | `/pix-review-ai`            |
| `architect`     | `/pix-plan-architect`     | `/pix-audit-architect`     | `/pix-review-architect`     |
| `auth`          | `/pix-plan-auth`          | `/pix-audit-auth`          | `/pix-review-auth`          |
